title: Stolen funds cleaned by a wash sale and gambling and paid out by a platform
summary: An attacker empties an exchange. The funds pass through a wash sale, a token swap and a gambling site, and a payment platform pays them into a bank account.

basis.note: A case follows one slice of the stolen funds. The slice is sized so that a payment platform could pay it to a personal account in medium payments, and its range is assumed.

references.note: The report describes each method separately. The library combines them as an example.
